documents.content: Recall is active only with a PostgreSQL mount. SQLite sessions do not load the embedding model or initialize recall.
Semantic vector retrieval and lexical full-text retrieval run concurrently. Reciprocal rank fusion combines their ranked results.
LocalEmbedder uses potion-base-8M to generate normalized 256-dimensional embeddings in-process. Content never goes to a remote API.
RecallScope separates project, session, and global namespaces. SQL filters prevent memories from leaking across projects.
A CancellationToken stops outstanding recall actions. The request deadline aborts pending searches and drains asynchronous work.
If semantic embedding fails, lexical retrieval can still return degraded results with a warning. Both retrieval branches failing is an error.
A model fingerprint hashes tokenizer.json, model.safetensors, and config.json. Changing model artifacts requires explicit reindexing.
The recall migration installs scoped memory tables and PostgreSQL storage functions. Recall has its own migration ledger, independent of the VFS state migrations.
Embedding is computed before inserting a memory. Failed embeddings leave no partial write. Batch indexing is transactional.
chaos-synopsis compiles a bounded acyclic workflow into a Bonsai behavior tree. Each action runs once per request.
Recall results preserve document IDs, namespaces, source metadata, and matched retrieval methods so users can trace their origin.
CPU inference runs on blocking workers. A semaphore limits concurrent embeddings and retains its permit until cancelled CPU work finishes.
The HTTP daemon serves browser requests and configures route handlers and authentication.
Git branches organize source changes. Pull requests run continuous integration before merging.
The terminal chat composer displays submitted messages and command completion popups.
Database-backed hooks run shell commands at session startup and before turns after approval.
Recurring jobs schedule actions at regular intervals with cron expressions.
An MCP server exposes external tools over stdio or HTTP transports and advertises capabilities.
Session history search uses literal text matching to retrieve persisted conversation entries.
SQLite is a local database used to persist runtime sessions and planning records on one machine.
Image classifiers compare pixel features and vector representations to identify objects in photographs.
Remote language model providers generate chat completions using hosted inference APIs.
Filesystem sandbox rules restrict writes outside the current workspace and writable temporary directories.
The daemon memory system tracks confidence and access counts, then decays unused memories over time.
